description: Implement consensus / majority voting (#1) in OptimizationRunner.tsx: run analyst model tests 3x with in-flight dedup, calculate majority/average score, gated by a consensus toggle defaulting to on.
verification: Analyst models run 3x when consensus toggle is active; average/majority scores computed; toggle controls behavior; unit tests pass.

description: Implement 429 exponential backoff with Retry-After header parsing (#2) and circuit-breaker-aware failover (#3): skip OPEN circuit models in failover loops, back off 2s->4s->8s (cap 30s) per provider.
verification: Grader failover checks Retry-After header and backs off exponentially per provider; OPEN circuits are bypassed in failover iterations.

description: Implement per-role output token caps (#4) on analyst (~1500), manager (~2000), grader (60), prompt-gen (300), and persist grader cache (#5) to localStorage with 24h TTL.
verification: Token caps forwarded and enforced on backend/engine; grader cache survives page reloads via localStorage.

description: Implement Cost Dashboard (#6) in CortexDiagnosticsViewer (tokens burned, estimated cost USD, error rate) and wire up/streamline reward system (#7).
verification: Diagnostics view renders cost metrics; reward telemetry is cleanly integrated with failover priorities.

description: Implement auto-quarantine for dead models after 3 consecutive 404s (#8), prompt-generation result caching (#10) in memory + localStorage, and concurrent optimizer execution (#9) with adaptive delays.
verification: Models hitting 3 consecutive 404s are quarantined; test prompts are cached; models run concurrently up to batch size 3.

description: Implement actionable error mapping (#11), grader single-model JSON retry (#12), prompt truncation in live stream events (#13), user task boundary hardening (#14), and lastError string truncation (#15).
verification: Errors mapped with stack traces stripped; grader retries once on malformed JSON; stream prompts truncated to 800 chars; user tasks wrapped in <user_task>; lastError truncated to 500 chars.

description: Drop empty knowledge-graph block when zero (#16), add visible Model Router decision chip (#17), combo-history reuse within 7 days (#18), and one-click apply full winning config button (#19).
verification: Empty KG block omitted from response; router decision chip visible in header; prior combo scores reused within 7 days; full winning config button applies all models.

description: Run the entire test suite (vitest, npm test), TypeScript lint checks (npm run lint), and production build (npm run build) to ensure zero regressions across all components.
verification: All unit, CLI, portable, simulation, and server tests pass; zero TypeScript errors; clean production build.
